response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive software development experience across multiple languages and domains, including embedded systems and networked applications, but his background leans heavily toward high-level web/mobile development rather than embedded networking or firmware security. His C experience is limited to early career roles, and there's no clear evidence of Linux kernel modification, MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, or network switch expertise. Native Japanese proficiency is also unconfirmed.
strengths: Strong general software engineering skills with broad language experience (C, C++, D, JavaScript/TypeScript)
Proven ability to work in embedded systems (National Instruments, robotic arms) and real-time applications
Demonstrated interest in security through workshops (e.g., testing random number generators) and open-source contributions
concerns: Limited direct experience with core required technologies: C for embedded systems, Linux kernel modification, network security protocols (MACsec, IEEE 802.1X)
No clear evidence of Layer-2/Layer-3 networking switch development or chip-vendor SDK usage
Unverified native Japanese proficiency and minimal networking-specific technical skills on resume
